items.summary: Update monthly total calculations and display for habits whose unit type is neither "reps" nor "time": the monthly total must equal the number of selected day checkboxes (each checked day counts as +1), and the UI must show both the monthly total and the goal in the existing monthly totals/volumes area for the habit row.

Ensure the "16/8 fasting" habit follows the non-(reps/time) monthly total behavior: monthly total increments by 1 per checked day and displays the goal alongside the monthly total in the existing monthly totals/volumes area.

Revise the habit editing UI so edit controls are not visible on the main grid: remove the always/hover-visible inline edit buttons for name/unit/volume from the habit row, and instead make clicking/tapping a habit open a small pop-up with a single edit-pen action; selecting the pen must open a full habit edit modal that allows changing all habit details currently editable in the app (including name, unit type, and the selected month’s volume/goal).
